incident.symptom: The frozen preimplementation design selected gh release download by tag to reauthenticate a draft release.
incident.false_inference: An authenticated tag-based release download can resolve the exact draft returned by the authenticated releases-list endpoint.
incident.cause: GitHub documents the get-release-by-tag path for published releases, while a draft asset is unambiguously addressable through the authenticated release-asset endpoint and its asset ID.
incident.prevention: Require a positive integer asset ID from the exact draft record, download each asset through the authenticated release-asset endpoint, and reject tag-based draft downloads.

primary_authorities.title: REST API endpoints for release assets - Get a release asset
primary_authorities.assertion: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/assets/{asset_id} with Accept application/octet-stream returns the binary directly or by redirect.

primary_authorities.title: REST API endpoints for releases - Get a release by tag name
primary_authorities.assertion: Tag lookup is not the authenticated draft-asset identity frozen by the releases-list response.

primary_authorities.title: GitHub CLI gh api manual
primary_authorities.assertion: gh api accepts exact endpoints and custom HTTP headers without a shell redirect.
